capabilities: Probabilistic record linkage and match diagnostics
limitation: Propagate uncertain links; false merges can induce causal bias
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Record comparisons, blocking rules and a probabilistic linkage model.
scientific_qualification.output: Pairwise match probabilities and thresholded/clustered candidate entity IDs.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Comparison-model calibration, blocking recall and dependence among fields; linkage uncertainty may depend on treatment/outcome.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Preserve match uncertainty and the linkage-data clock. A hard connected component is an estimated entity, not ground truth; avoid post-treatment features when defining baseline identities without justification.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Inject treatment-dependent false merges/splits and quantify their effect on the causal contrast; compare integration over candidate links with a hard-threshold analysis.

evidence.finding: Probabilistic linkage, Fellegi-Sunter basis, pair probabilities, clustering and highly correlated field limitation.
